Issue body actions

**[WIP][GOAL] Copilot individual-tier /models: no silent empty model lists — every fetch failure names its branch (exchange / HTTP / filter), per-tier dialect tests (individual/business/enterprise), dual-path fallback before giving up**

## Live repro (owner machine, 2026-10-30)

`fa /models` lists 13 models for `copilot-Uladzimir_Klyshevich_epam` (enterprise host), models for `copilot-uk-epam` (business host) — and **NOTHING for `copilot-IstiN`** (individual, `https://api.githubcopilot.com`). The provider is unusable for model selection, with zero diagnostics. Owner report: «создал copilot провайдер на individual — не могу у него выбрать модели».

## RCA — the dialect swallows every failure into an empty list

`_CopilotDialect.fetch` (`models_for_endpoint.dart:316+`) has FOUR silent-empty exits, none distinguishable to the user:

1. **Token-exchange failure** — non-fine-grained keys go through `copilot_internal/v2/token`; classic PATs (`ghp_`) are known to be rejected there (Copilot API wants OAuth device-flow or fine-grained-with-Copilot-permission); OAuth edge cases on individual seats untested. On throw → `([], {}, {})`.
2. **HTTP failure** — `/models` non-200 (seat inactive, wrong tier host, header drift) → `([], {}, {})` after 15s timeout.
3. **Proxy-ep routing** — `copilotApiBaseUrlFromToken` returns **null for individual tokens by design** (comment at `copilot_oauth.dart:95`: "older/individual tokens carry no proxy-ep") → falls back to the configured base; if the user's configured host is wrong for their tier (or the tier host moves), 404 → silently empty.
4. **Filter drops everything** — `_isSelectableCopilotModel` requires `model_picker_enabled == true`, `policy.state != disabled`, `tool_calls != false`, `/chat/completions` in `supported_endpoints`. An individual-tier response shape with missing/absent `model_picker_enabled` filters out EVERY entry silently → empty with "success" status.

Which branch fired for `copilot-IstiN` is UNKNOWABLE today — that is the core bug: the code cannot report why it found nothing.

## Capability surface (the fix)

 <markdown-accessiblity-table>

|  Piece |  Contract |
| --- | --- |

|  Fetch diagnostics |  `/models` fetch returns a REASON on empty: which stage failed (exchange HTTP status / models HTTP status / timeout) and how many entries were filtered with per-model drop reasons (`picker flag absent`, `policy disabled`, `no tool_calls`, `endpoint unsupported`) |

|  UI surfacing |  the provider/model picker shows the reason inline («copilot-IstiN: 0 models — exchange 401 (classic PAT not accepted; use OAuth device flow or fine-grained PAT with Copilot permission)»), never a bare empty list |

|  Dual-path fallback |  on exchange-path failure with a non-OAuth key, retry the PAT-direct path (and vice versa) before declaring empty; result notes which path answered |

|  Tier validation |  per-tier host sanity: token proxy-ep absent + configured business/enterprise host → warning hint («individual tokens serve from api.githubcopilot.com — check the configured base URL») |

|  Bundled fallback |  existing bundled list used as last resort WITH the «fell back to bundled, live fetch failed: » note (today `onBundledFallback` exists upstream — verify it fires on every empty exit) |

</markdown-accessiblity-table>

## Acceptance criteria (testable)

- **AC1** — fake copilot servers per tier (individual / business / enterprise shapes incl. proxy-ep tokens, no-proxy tokens): each dialect branch returns parsed models; UT matrix over the four silent-exit branches, each now carrying its reason.
- **AC2** — filter transparency: a /models body where all entries lack `model_picker_enabled` yields reason «12 models fetched, 12 filtered (picker flag absent)» — not empty-without-explanation; UT for each filter criterion naming the dropped model.
- **AC3** — dual-path: exchange-401 with classic-PAT-shaped key → PAT-direct attempted → if it answers, models listed with a path note; both fail → combined reason.
- **AC4** — IT (fake servers): `fa /models` for an empty-result provider prints the reason; picker UI (line + app) renders it; a healthy individual-shaped response (picker flags true) lists models end-to-end.
- **AC5** — owner validation: with `copilot-IstiN` (individual), after the fix `/models` either lists models or shows the exact named failure (exchange status or filter counts) — the branch that fires TODAY becomes visible; if it is the classic-PAT/exchange branch, the hint names the OAuth device flow / fine-grained PAT remedies (both already supported by fa).
- **AC6** — REG: enterprise/business providers keep listing (their today-green paths untouched); bundled-fallback tests green.

## Non-goals

No new auth flows (OAuth device flow + fine-grained PAT exist — [gh-1606](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/issues/1606)); no model-list caching changes; no changes to chat-path token handling beyond reusing the same diagnostics; not reworking `_isSelectableCopilotModel` policy (its criteria stay; only reporting improves).

💡 **SUGGESTION: unbounded response body embedded in user-facing one-line diagnostics**

The 404/non-200 exchange failures embed `Body: ${response.body.trim()}` verbatim into `CopilotAuthException.message` (pre-existing text, `statusCode` added around it here). With gh-1990 that message now propagates through `ModelsFetchDiagnostic.message` into `fetch notes:` (CLI), the connect sheet, and the app's model field — all single-line UI surfaces. A misconfigured base URL pointing at an HTML endpoint (or a verbose gateway error page) can flood them with an arbitrarily long blob, and the body is shown raw with no redaction layer in front of it.

The exchange endpoint is api.github.com so today's bodies are tame JSON errors, but the cheap hardening is worth it while this code is being touched: cap the embedded body (e.g. `final snippet = response.body.trim(); '${snippet.length > 200 ? '${snippet.substring(0, 200)}…' : snippet}'`). Not a leak today — just future-proofing a string that now reaches five surfaces.

💡 **SUGGESTION: `_copilotModelsShapeValid` decodes the body a second time**

`_fetchModelsList` calls `_parseCopilotModelsResponse(response.body)` (which `jsonDecode`s the body and already knows whether `data` is a `List`), then on the empty branch calls `_copilotModelsShapeValid(response.body)`, which `jsonDecode`s the same body again just to re-derive the shape the parser already computed. Have the parser return the shape (or a `dataIsList` flag) and drop the second decode — one less JSON pass on every honest-empty answer, and the "empty list vs unexpected shape" distinction stops depending on a re-parse agreeing with the first one. Related: this helper is also one of the two unguarded `jsonDecode` sites (see the BLOCKING thread on `_fetchModelsList`) — folding it into the parser removes the duplicate hazard too.

## Review summary — PR #2001 (gh-1990, Copilot /models diagnostics)

**Verdict: 🚨 REQUEST_CHANGES** — 2 blocking, 1 important, 5 suggestions.

**🚨 BLOCKING 1 — refactor regression, proven by execution:** `_parseCopilotModelsResponse(response.body)` now runs outside any try/catch (the old `on Object → empty` catch was dropped in the rewrite). An HTTP 200 with a non-JSON body (captive portal, proxy error page) throws `FormatException` out of `fetchModelsForEndpointReport` **and** the legacy `fetchModelsForEndpoint` — violating the file's own "empty on any error" dialect contract, the PR's AC6/REG claim, and crashing the one unguarded caller (CLI `/provider copilot` connect flow). I ran a scratch repro on this head: both APIs throw with the full stack through `_fetchModelsList:718`. The PR's tests missed exactly this branch. Fix = guard the parse and turn it into another named gh-1990 diagnostic + add the `modelsBody: 'not-json'` test.

**🚨 BLOCKING 2 — stray file:** `.dmtools-target-workingdir` (dmtools local tool-state marker) got committed by a WIP auto-save again; `main`'s `.gitignore` (commit `25e7ddf70d`, landed after this branch's merge-base) explicitly says "never commit (was swept into the PR by a WIP auto-save once already)". → `git rm --cached`.

**⚠️ IMPORTANT:** AC5 is still open — the owner's prime-suspect branch (`picker flag absent` on individual tier) is now *named* but still yields zero usable models; the gh-1990 guidance's phase-2 tier-aware filter needs a confirmed follow-up ticket. (I read the actual pi-mono `github-copilot.ts` this run: fa's strict picker criteria match pi, and pi solves the same individual-tier shape with an `allowPolicyFallback` when the strict list empties — cited in the thread.)

**💡 Suggestions:** fabricated `stage: 'exchange+models'` breaks the new type's documented closed vocabulary; contradictory doc wording ("Payloads without the field … are kept" — they're dropped); the `message — hint` join still hand-rolled at 2 sites beyond `ModelsFetchReport.reasonText`; unbounded response body now flowing into five one-line UI surfaces; `_copilotModelsShapeValid` re-decodes the body.

**Verified green in-review:** PR's core suites 24 ✅, fa_ui suites 23 ✅, `dart analyze` + `dart format` clean on touched files. Note: validation CI on head `91f9dea86f` is still pending (zombie re-dispatch).
